reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Michigan
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law allow a landlord to include a lease provision whereby
    a tenant waives their right to notice?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

state(michigan).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
rental_agreement(lease1).
parties_to_agreement(lease1, landlord1, tenant1).

% The lease includes a provision where the tenant waives their right to notice.
% We model this as a lease provision that waives "a right of notice ... required by law
% in a judicial proceeding arising under the rental agreement."
lease_includes_provision(lease1, provision1).
provision_type(provision1, waiver_of_notice_in_judicial_proceeding).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario matches the question.
scenario_statement :-
    state(michigan),
    focus_year(2021),
    rental_agreement(lease1),
    parties_to_agreement(lease1, landlord1, tenant1),
    lease_includes_provision(lease1, provision1),
    provision_type(provision1, waiver_of_notice_in_judicial_proceeding).

% -----------------------------
% Statute encoding: MI Comp L  554.633 (2021)
% -----------------------------

/*
  MI Comp L  554.633(1): A rental agreement shall not include a provision that does 1 or more
  prohibited things, including:
  (f) "Waives or alters a party's right to demand a trial by jury or any other right of notice
      or procedure required by law in a judicial proceeding arising under the rental agreement."
*/

% Classify provisions that fall under  554.633(1)(f).
statute_mi_554_633_1_f_provision(Provisions) :-
    provision_type(Provisions, waiver_of_notice_in_judicial_proceeding).

% A provision is prohibited under  554.633 if it matches any prohibited category.
% (For this question, we only need (1)(f), but we keep the structure extensible.)
statute_mi_554_633_prohibited_provision(Agreement, Provision) :-
    rental_agreement(Agreement),
    lease_includes_provision(Agreement, Provision),
    statute_mi_554_633_1_f_provision(Provision).

/*
  MI Comp L  554.633(3): "A provision or clause of a rental agreement that violates this section is void."
*/
statute_mi_554_633_void(Agreement, Provision) :-
    statute_mi_554_633_prohibited_provision(Agreement, Provision).

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning: "allowed to include" vs prohibited/void
% -----------------------------

% If a provision is prohibited/void under  554.633, the landlord is not allowed to include it.
law_allows_landlord_to_include_provision(Agreement, Provision, no) :-
    statute_mi_554_633_prohibited_provision(Agreement, Provision),
    statute_mi_554_633_void(Agreement, Provision),
    !.

% Otherwise, (under the given statute set) it is allowed.
law_allows_landlord_to_include_provision(Agreement, Provision, yes) :-
    rental_agreement(Agreement),
    lease_includes_provision(Agreement, Provision),
    \+ statute_mi_554_633_prohibited_provision(Agreement, Provision),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Answer predicate required by the prompt
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    law_allows_landlord_to_include_provision(lease1, provision1, Result),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law allow a landlord to include a lease provision whereby a tenant waives their right to notice?
